name: import_addresses
description: CRITICAL: Call this tool to report the mapping of Terraform resource addresses to cloud resource IDs found in the workspace, and to signal the end of the inspection task.

address.description: The Terraform resource address for the generated block (e.g. 'azurerm_storage_account.example', 'module.keyvault.azurerm_key_vault.main').

resource_id.description: The import ID, in the exact format the "Import" section of the resource type's Terraform Registry documentation specifies for the provider version in use. The format depends on the provider and the resource type, for any provider: for example a name ('acme-logs' for aws_s3_bucket), a short id ('vpc-0123' for aws_vpc), a full ARN, Azure resource ID or OCID, a composite ('n/<namespace>/b/<bucket>' for oci_objectstorage_bucket), or an inventory path ('/dc1/vm/web01' for vsphere_virtual_machine). Every value in it is copied byte for byte from the listed id; only the format and the spelling of structural segments come from the documentation.

listed_id.description: The listed id from `<selected_resource_ids>` this import ID was built from, copied unchanged (for a previous attempt, its `listed_id`). It is kept with the attempt so that, if the import is rejected, a retry can rebuild the import ID from it.

imports.description: The mapping of each generated resource block to the cloud resource it represents. Each entry feeds directly into `terraform import <address> <resource_id>`.

summary.description: A detailed, human-readable narrative of the inspection: which files were inspected, which resource blocks were found, and for each resource type the documented import format applied and the provider version it came from.
